architecture_refinement.reason: Multiple queued workflow runs can target the same bounded semantic test family while differing in controller commit/workflow packaging. Counting dispatches as independent semantic evidence would inflate experiment count and can hide scheduler blockage.

runtime_transport_evidence_keys.semantic_subject_digest: Digest of the exact bounded product/runtime proposition and exact target artifact/source identity being tested.
runtime_transport_evidence_keys.dispatch_instance_id: Concrete transport attempt identity such as controller repo + workflow run id + job id + controller head SHA.
runtime_transport_evidence_keys.transport_generation: Monotonic or provenance-bound attempt generation for the same semantic subject where current authority admits a successor.
runtime_transport_evidence_keys.supersedes_dispatch_instance_id: Optional explicit relation when a newer transport attempt intentionally replaces an older one.

architecture_refinement.credit_rule: Two queued/unassigned dispatch instances for the same or unresolved semantic subject contribute zero independent runtime replication credit. Only executed exact-subject receipts may be counted, and independence must be established separately from transport multiplicity.
architecture_refinement.planning_rule: Do not invent a single canonical transport pointer when current evidence explicitly retains multiple unresolved instances. Preserve all unresolved dispatch identities and let Trigger4 reconcile which one is authoritative/superseded after execution or explicit authority update.

next_exact_action: Trigger4 should preserve and observe both unresolved dispatch identities without adding another retry. Obtain direct runner lifecycle/eligibility visibility if an authorized surface becomes callable. If one or both existing jobs execute, bind each receipt to its dispatch_instance_id and semantic_subject_digest before deciding semantic equivalence, supersession, or replication credit.
